original:
The function $g_{k,a,b}$ is periodic. If $\operatorname{gcd}(a,b)=1$ , its least positive period is $Q_{k,a}$ , where

 $Q_{k,a}:=\frac{L_{k}}{\delta_{k,a}\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}q\text{ prime }\\
q\mid\operatorname{gcd}\left(a,L_{k}\right)\end{subarray}}q^{e_{q,k}}},$ 

and

 $\delta_{k,a}:=\begin{cases}p^{e_{p,k}},&\text{ if }p\nmid a\text{ and }v_{p}(k+1)\geq e_{p,k}\text{ for some prime }p\leq k,\\
1,&\text{ otherwise }.\end{cases}$ 

If $\operatorname{gcd}(a,b)>1$ , its least positive period is $Q_{k,a^{\prime}}$ , where
 $a^{\prime}=\frac{a}{\operatorname{gcd}(a,b)}$ .
